svg.metadata: {"story":"Noah","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · The Warning","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The Lord warns Noah of the coming flood, and he is told to make an ark of gopher wood, for the earth is filled with violence.
